## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL regime; Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmation 1: broad sector participation but clustered upside in Energy; Confirmation 2: large-cap tech divergences (AAPL, GOOGL, META weak while NVDA, LRCX, AMD show strength) suppress a clear directional call; Leadership: Narrow (Top 5 all Energy).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND. Financials showing steady support: JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND. Technology pockets of strength: LRCX (1W: +6.75% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +2.68%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Consumer Staples and Consumer Discretionary lag: MNST (1W: -50.28% | 1M: -52.01%) BELOW TREND, HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND. Materials soft overall with FCX (1W: -4.50% | 1M: +13.54%) in CORRECTION and sector tone muted.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND; VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND; PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND; COP (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +12.35%) ABOVE TREND; CVX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +8.78%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Energy), concentration risk elevated.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: AMZN (1W: -4.31% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION; FCX (1W: -4.50% | 1M: +13.54%) CORRECTION; RCL (1W: -4.69% | 1M: +3.76%) CORRECTION; HON (1W: -4.69% | 1M: +3.68%) CORRECTION; HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in select consumer and cyclicals.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +6.75% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +2.68%) ABOVE TREND; Major divergence present (≥3 large names with 1W ≠ 1M) — watch for trend break rather than assuming broad continuation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but constructive in parts: NVDA (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.56%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +6.75% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +6.28% | 1M: +17.26%) ABOVE TREND versus AAPL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND and MSFT (1W: -0.92% | 1M: +23.51%) CORRECTION — Tech breadth mixed; rotation within the group.

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive and steady: JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.64% | 1M: -0.09%) RECOVERY — Financials providing ballast for equities.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Divergent defensives and insurers: JNJ (1W: +0.43% | 1M: +4.15%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +8.43%) ABOVE TREND versus UNH (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -5.11%) BELOW TREND and LLY (1W: -0.33% | 1M: +1.08%) CORRECTION — sector mixed on drug/insurance headlines.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Given NEUTRAL regime with narrow Energy leadership, favor exposure to Energy and selective Financials (MPC, PSX, JPM) and reduce exposure to large-cap tech showing exhaustion (AAPL, GOOGL, META). Style: Value/Cyclical tilt while watching for scope of rotation to broaden.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +6.75% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND, HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND, CSCO (1W: -8.03% | 1M: +1.84%) CORRECTION.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +9.05% | 1M: +10.77%) — concentration risk but momentum; Financials steady (1W: +1.64% | 1M: +3.03%). BEARISH: Consumer Staples and Consumer Discretionary lagging (Consumer Stpl. 1W: -3.36% | 1M: -3.24%).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.56%) ABOVE TREND — hold above recent 1M pivot to confirm continuation; AAPL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND — failure to reclaim 1M range confirms ongoing weakness; JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND — sustained bids above weekly pivot would support Financials.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
MPC (+65): Marathon surge after Q2 (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirming price action. AMAT (+60): Positive AI commentary but price is weak short-term with AMAT (1W: -5.93% | 1M: -9.58%) BELOW TREND — sentiment diverging, watch for follow-through. SPG (+85): strong FFO/guide (SPG not in detailed list here) — monitor for confirmation in price.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
AAPL (-50): Analyst downgrades (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. CSCO (-50): downgrade chatter while CSCO (1W: -8.03% | 1M: +1.84%) CORRECTION — sentiment and price diverging; watch for distribution. UNH (-45): Medicare cost worries with UNH (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -5.11%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirming insurer pressure.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime with a Value/Cyclical tilt given concentrated Energy leadership and steady Financials. MPC, PSX, CVX showing relative strength (ABOVE TREND) while AAPL, GOOGL, META are showing weakness (BELOW TREND). Key risk is narrow leadership and major divergence between large-cap tech and sector-level breadth; monitor news-driven divergences (AMAT bullish headlines vs AMAT BELOW TREND).
